capabilities: Remove borders, padding, and margins from embeds
Hide embed titles and link icons
Match divider lines inside embeds to full document width
Support nested embeds in Reading mode and Live Preview
extras: No settings are available; the plugin applies its styling automatically once enabled.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that makes embedded (transcluded) notes visually indistinguishable from the surrounding text.
problem: Obsidian renders embeds with a border, indentation, and link icon that visually break the flow of transcluded content within a document.
summary: CSS-based plugin that renders embedded notes (![[...]]) without borders, padding, titles, or icons so they blend into surrounding text.
